title: Myris
summary: Raleigh names Myris in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Myris, also written Meris, who caused the great Lake to be made which beares his name. Reineccius takes Armeus to haue beene this man. Raleigh doth not follow that, and this Myris is not Thermutis. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, §. III, sig. 357a
